CITY COUNCIL
DECEMBER 9, 2024
PUBLIC MEETING: 4:30 P.M.
PASADENA CITY HALL, COUNCIL CHAMBER
100 NORTH GARFIELD AVENUE, ROOM S249
NOTE TO PUBLIC :
PUBLIC COMMENT IS LIMITED TO THIS SPECIAL MEETING AGENDA, AND LIMITED TO
IN-PERSON COMMENTS ONLY
NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the Special
Organizational Meeting of the City Council will be held on Monday, December 9,
2024, at 4:30 p.m., to discuss the matters listed below.
ORGANIZATIONAL MEETING

Measures PA,

CITY OF PASADENA
  City Council Minutes
  December 9, 2024 - 4:30 P.M.
  City Hall Council Chamber
  SPECIAL ORGANIZATIONAL MEETING

  OPENING:  Mayor Gordo called the organizational meeting to order at 4:44 p.m.
  The pledge of allegiance was led by Councilmember Williams.
  (Absent: Councilmember Hampton)

  ROLL CALL:  Mayor Victor M. Gordo
  Councilmembers:  Vice Mayor Steve Madison
  Councilmember Tyron Hampton (arrived at 6:04 p.m.)
  Councilmember Justin Jones
  Councilmember Jason Lyon
  Councilmember Gene Masuda
  Councilmember Jessica Rivas
  Councilmember Felicia Williams

  Staff:  City Manager Miguel Marquez
  City Attorney/City Prosecutor Michele Beal Bagneris
  City Clerk Mark Jomsky

  ADOPTION OF A RESOLUTION ACCEPTING THE
  "CERTIFICATE OF THE CANVASS OF THE ELECTION
  RETURNS" AS PREPARED AND CERTIFIED BY THE LOS
  ANGELES COUNTY REGISTRAR-RECORDER/COUNTY CLERK
  FOR THE PASADENA GENERAL MUNICIPAL ELECTION
  CONSOLIDATED WITH THE NOVEMBER 5, 2024, STATEWIDE
  GENERAL ELECTION
  Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council:
  (1) Find that the proposed action in the agenda report is not a
  project subject to California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) as
  defined in Section 21065 and Section 15378 of the State CEQA
  Guidelines, and as such, no environmental document pursuant to
  CEQA is required for the project; and
  (2) Adopt a resolution accepting the "Certificate of the Canvass of
  the Election Returns" (Exhibit A to the resolution) as prepared and
  certified by the Los Angeles County Registrar-Recorder/County
  Clerk for the Pasadena General Municipal Election, consolidated
  with the Statewide General Election held on November 5, 2024,
  resulting in the passage of Measure PL (Library Bond Measure), and
  Charter Amendment Measures PA, PB, PC, PF, and PR amending
  the Pasadena City Charter. (Resolution No.10103)

u  City Clerk Jomsky provided a brief recap of the March 5, 2024
  Primary Election results, reporting on the following individuals as re-
  elected and elected to Office:

  Council Minutes  1  12/09/2024
   Victor M. Gordo, having received 81.6% of the total votes cast
  for the Office of Mayor of Pasadena, was declared to be re-
  elected to that office.

  Tyron Hampton, having received 100% of the total votes cast
  for the Office of Member of the City Council from District 1, was
  declared to be re-elected to that office.

  Rick Cole, having received 59.8% of the total votes cast for the
  Office Member of the City Council from District 2, was declared
  to be elected to that office.

  Gene Masuda, having received 66.4% of the total votes cast for
  the Office of Member of the City Council from District 4, was
  declared to be re-elected to that office.

  Steve Madison, having received 100% of the total votes cast for
  the Office of Member of the City Council from District 6, was
  declared to be re-elected to that office.

  In a Special Election to fill the remaining two years of an
  unexpired term (set to expire on December 7, 2026), Justin L.
  Jones, having received 55.2% of the total votes cast for the
  Office of Member of City Council from District 3, was declared
  to be elected to that office.

  City Clerk Jomsky also provided a recap on the November 5, 2024
  General Election, reporting the following results on ballot measures
  PL (Central Library Earthquake Retrofit GO Bond Measure), PA
  (Elections/Appointments), PB (Vice Mayor/Acting Mayor), PC (Term
  Limits), PF (Fire and Police Retirement System Board), and PR
  (Rent Control):

  Measure PL received 44,835 "Yes" votes and 17,074 "No"
  votes, with "Yes" votes receiving 72.4%. To be approved,
  Measure PL required a two-thirds majority of the voters cast to
  be in favor and pass, and is deemed approved by the voters.

  City Clerk Jomsky also reported on the following City Charter
  Amendment Measures that required a 50%+1 majority of the votes
  cast to be in favor and pass:

  Measure PA received 49,877 "Yes" votes and 7,841 "No" votes;
  with 86.4% of "Yes" votes cast, Measure PA is deemed
  approved by the voters.

  Measure PB received 48,524 "Yes" votes and 8,163 "No" votes;
  with 85.6% of "Yes" votes cast, Measure PB is deemed
  approved by the voters.

Council Minutes  2  12/09/2024
   Measure PC received 47,398 "Yes" votes and 10,432 "No"
  votes; with 81.96% of "Yes" votes cast, Measure PC is deemed
r~  approved by the voters.

  Measure PF received 48,196 "Yes" votes and 8,082 "No" votes;
  with 85.6% of "Yes" votes cast, Measure PF is deemed
  approved by the voters.

  Measure PR received 35,351 "Yes" votes and 19,999 "No"
  votes; with 63.87% of "Yes" votes cast, Measure PR is deemed
  approved by the voters.

  City Clerk Jomsky noted that with 67,340 ballots cast, and 89,696
  registered voters in Pasadena, the voter turnout for the November 5,
  2024 General Election was 75.1%.

  MOTION:  It was moved by Councilmember Lyon, seconded by Councilmember
  Jones, to approve the staff recommendation. (Motion unanimously
  approved) (Absent: Councilmember Hampton)

  RECOGNIZE END OF TERM OF VICE MAYOR

  On behalf of the City Council Mayor Gordo expressed appreciation
  and gratitude to Steve Madison for his service as Vice Mayor.

  Outgoing Vice Mayor Madison thanked Mayor Gordo for the
  recognition, and expressed his gratitude for the opportunity to serve
  as Vice Mayor this past year and for the second time during his
  tenure on the City Council.

  RECOGNIZE END OF TERM OF OUTGOING COUNCILMEMBER

  Paul Cheng, Arcadia City Councilmember; Jubilee Byfield, on behalf
  of Congresswoman Judy Chu; State Senator Sasha Renee Perez;
  State Assemblymember John Harabedian; Savannah Moore, on
  behalf of LA County Board Supervisor Kathryn Barger; Dominick
  Correy, on behalf of the Rose Bowl Operating Company; David
  Reyes, Acting General Manager, on behalf of Pasadena Water and
  Power staff; City Manager Marquez on behalf of the Executive
  Management team; and Mayor Gordo, on behalf of the City Council;
  all thanked outgoing Councilmember Williams for her commitment
  and dedication to serving the community, advocating for the well-
  being of all constituents, and making positive impacts on the City of
  Pasadena during her four-year term as Councilmember representing
  Council District 2.

  Councilmember Williams thanked everyone for their kind remarks,
  and reflected on the accomplishments of the City Council during her
  four-year term, including the number of affordable housing projects
  built in the City, the regional expansion of the Pasadena Outreach

  Council Minutes  3  12/09/2024
   Response Team (PORT) program being simulated in other cities and
  jurisdictions, implementation of a new bad weather shelter, and
  increasing services for homelessness. She also expressed heartfelt
  gratitude to Darla Dyson for her service as the District 2 Liaison, and
  to many of the City staff for working towards achieving the City's
  goals and continuously serving the community.

ADJOURN CITY  Following discussion, it was moved by Councilmember Williams,
COUNCIL SINE DIE  seconded by Councilmember Lyon, to adjourn the City Council sine
  die, as presently constituted:

  AYES: Councilmembers Jones, Lyon, Madison, Masuda,
  Rivas, Williams, Mayor Gordo
  NOES: None
  ABSENT: Councilmember Hampton
  ABSTAIN: None

RECESS  The City Council recessed the meeting at 5:24 p.m.

RECONVENE/  Mayor Gordo reconvened the meeting at 6:04 p.m.
SWEARING-IN
  Judge William Crowfoot administered the Oaths of Office to
Councilmember Hampton  Councilmember Rick Cole and Mayor Victor Gordo.
arrived at 6:04 p.m.
  City Clerk Jomsky administered the Oath of Office to
  Councilmembers Tyron Hampton, Justin Jones, Gene Masuda, and
  Steve Madison.

  Councilmembers Jones, Madison, Masuda, Hampton, Cole, and
  Mayor Gordo all made brief comments, with each expressing their
  immense gratitude and appreciation for their families, friends, District
  Liaisons, constituents, and supporters.

ELECTION OF VICE  Mayor Gordo opened the floor for nominations for a new Vice Mayor.
MAYOR
  Councilmember Madison nominated Councilmember Rivas as Vice
  Mayor.

  MOTION:  Following brief discussion, was moved by Councilmember Madison,
  seconded by Councilmember Hampton, to nominate Jessica Rivas
  as Vice Mayor, for a one-year term beginning on December 9,2024
  through December 8, 2025.

  Councilmember Madison noted for those in attendance that under
  the voter-approved Charter Amendment Measure PB, the term for
  Vice Mayor is one year and a City Council Reorganization Meeting
  is required to occur annually in December.

Council Minutes  4  12/09/2024
   AYES: Councilmembers Cole, hlampton, Jones, Lyon,
  Madison, Masuda, Rivas, Mayor Gordo
  NOES: None
  ABSENT: None
  ABSTAIN: None

STATEMENTS/  On behalf of the City Council, Mayor Gordo thanked those in
CONCLUDING  attendance and those watching from home, including colleagues,
REMARKS  families, friends, and all constituents of Pasadena, for the honor and
  privilege to serve the City.
